autoroles.label: Auto roles
autoroles.description: Assigns roles when a member joins, and a role while connected to voice.

roleIds.label: Roles given to members on arrival
roleIds.help: Granted to every human who joins the server, straight away. The bot must be able to give them: they have to sit BELOW its own role in the hierarchy, otherwise nothing is granted and nothing says so. Also needs the privileged « Server Members » intent.

botRoleIds.label: Roles given to bots
botRoleIds.help: Granted instead of the ones above when the arriving account is a bot. Useful to file bots under their own heading in the member list, and to keep human-only access away from them.

voiceRoleIds.label: Roles held while in a voice channel
voiceRoleIds.help: Granted while a member is connected to a voice channel, and removed as soon as they leave. Mostly used to open a text channel reserved for whoever is in voice.
